# Hover

Hover is the property intelligence platform that turns a scan of any residential or commercial property into high-quality 3D data, complete with accurate measurements, structured documentation, and reliable estimates.

Whether you're a contractor winning bids or an adjuster closing claims, Hover gives every property professional a single, verified source of truth - from first scan to final estimate.
